subtitle: Global video streaming at planetary scale

panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- Multi-device streaming (TV, Mobile, Web)
- Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) switching
- Personalized rows and ranking
- Offline downloads (DRM protected)
- Profiles and watch history sync

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Real-time live sports/streaming
- Content licensing & legal workflows
- Payment gateway internals
- Social features (comments/sharing)
